subject: Obstruction - Fender - Lake Ontario - Port Hope
text:
Obstruction - Fender - Lake Ontario - Port Hope
Privately maintained orange and white lighted mooring buoy with a flashing amber light and a radar reflector marking the shipwreck "P.B. Locke" placed for the season at 43 54.971N 078 17.930W.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-3555-25
